blocks.raw:
<WikiTableTabs
  caption="BP 344 ramp checks from the cited Appendix A excerpts"
  tables='[{"id": "bp344-ramp-geometry", "title": "Ramp geometry", "content": "| Check | Governing value | Condition | Exam trap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Clear width | 1200 mm minimum | Accessible ramp clear width | Confusing clear width with constructed width after rails or finishes |
| General gradient | Not steeper than 1:20 | Ordinary accessible ramp condition | Treating a steeper special-case row as the default rule |
| 1:15 row | 10.50 m maximum length and 700 mm maximum rise | Special table condition | Using 1:15 without checking length and rise together |
| Intermediate landing | 1800 mm minimum length | Ramp total length longer than 10.50 m | Checking slope but forgetting the landing trigger |"}, {"id": "bp344-ramp-handrails", "title": "Handrail checks", "content": "| Check | Governing value | Condition | Exam trap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Handrail trigger | Change in grade higher than 170 mm | Accessible ramp condition | Assuming slope alone decides compliance |
| Handrail heights | 900 mm and 700 mm | Ramps and stairs | Answering only one handrail height |
| End extension | 300 mm horizontal extension | Before the start and after the end | Forgetting the extension after drawing the ramp run |
| Wall clearance | 50 mm minimum | Handrail attached to walls | Measuring only rail height and missing wall clearance |"}]'
/>
